messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

message.content:
Below is a quick‑reference calendar of **Canadian statutory holidays** for 2023, annotated with the weekday they fell on and whether they automatically created a *long weekend* (a three‑day break that includes at least one Saturday or Sunday).  
(For brevity only the most widely observed “federal” holidays are listed—provincial variations are noted where relevant.)

| # | Date (2023) | Holiday | Weekday | Provinces/territories that observe it | Does it make a long weekend? |
|---|-------------|---------|--------|--------------------------------------|------------------------------|
| 1 | January 01 | New Year’s Day | Sun | All | Yes – many workers take Mon 02 off (but not mandatory) |
| 2 | February 20 | Family Day | Mon | BC, AB, SK, NB | ✔️ (Mon‑Wed) |
| 3 | April 07 | Good Friday | Fri | All | ✔️ (Fri‑Sun) |
| 4 | April 10 | Easter Monday | Mon | Some employers & certain provinces (e.g., Ontario) | ✔️ (Mon‑Tue) |
| 5 | May 22 | Victoria Day | Mon | All except Quebec | ✔️ (Mon‑Thu) |
| 6 | July 01 | Canada Day | Sat | All | ❌ (Sat alone unless adjacent to another holiday) |
| 7 | August 14 | Civic Holiday | Mon | Most provinces (except QC, ON, PEI) | ✔️ (Mon‑Thu) |
| 8 | September 04 | Labour Day | Mon | All | ✔️ (Mon‑Thu) |
| 9 | October 09 | Thanksgiving | Mon | All | ✔️ (Mon‑Thu) |
|10 | November 11 | Remembrance Day | Wed | All | ❌ (unless combined with other days) |
|11 | December 25 | Christmas Day | Mon | All | ✔️ (Mon‑Thu) |
|12 | December 26 | Boxing Day | Tue | All | ❌ (only two consecutive days) |

### How to use this in your app

1. **Display the full list** so users see every statutory holiday.  
2. **Highlight the “✔️” rows** (or color code them) to indicate automatic long weekends.  
3. If you support **province‑specific calendars**, add a filter that shows/hides holidays per region.  

#### Example JSON snippet (for integration):

```json
[
  {
    "date": "2023-01-01",
    "holiday": "New Year's Day",
    "weekday": "Sunday",
    "provinces": ["All"],
    "longWeekend": true,
    "notes": "Many take Monday off"
  },
  ...
  {
    "date": "2023-08-14",
    "holiday": "Civic Holiday",
    "weekday": "Monday",
    "provinces": ["Alberta","British Columbia", ...],
    "longWeekend": true
  }
]
```

Feel free to tweak the data structure to match your existing schema!
message.reasoning:
The user wants a list of long weekends (public holidays) for Canada in 2023. They want it integrated into their holiday planning app. We can provide them with a list.

We should consider what constitutes a long weekend: typically public holidays that fall near weekends such that they create extended breaks. In Canada, there are federal statutory holidays but provinces have different ones too. But likely they'd want national holidays. For simplicity we could give all Canadian statutory holidays in 2023 along with dates; then highlight those that result in long weekends (i.e., if holiday falls on Friday or Monday). Or just list all holidays.

But maybe better to produce a table:

Date - Holiday - Day of week - Long Weekend?

List of Canadian statutory holidays 2023:
New Year's Day – Jan 1 (Sunday)
Family Day – Feb 20 (Monday) [BC, AB, SK, NB]
Good Friday – Apr 7 (Friday)
Easter Monday – Apr 10 (Monday) [not a statutory holiday federally but some employers observe]
Victoria Day – May 22 (Monday)
Canada Day – Jul 1 (Saturday)
Civic Holiday – Aug 14 (Monday) [varies by province]
Labour Day – Sep 4 (Monday)
Thanksgiving – Oct 9 (Monday)
Remembrance Day – Nov 11 (Wednesday)
Christmas Day – Dec 25 (Monday)
Boxing Day – Dec 26 (Tuesday)

Also other provincial holidays: Thanksgiving etc.

Long weekends would include Good Friday + Easter Monday (if observed), Family day (makes long weekend?), Victoria Day (already Monday so long weekend), Civic Holiday (Monday), Labour Day (Monday), Thanksgiving (Monday).

So we can present as a list of long weekends: e.g.:

Jan 2–5 (since New Year Sunday -> Monday off?) Actually New Year's Day was Sunday, no bank holiday? Many people take Monday off. Not official though.

Better to show each holiday with its effect.
